data.name: Anna
data.gender_notes: Anna is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Ḥannah, from the root ḥ-n-n, 'to be gracious', via the Greek Anna. Its root is Hebrew ḥ-n-n. Anna the prophetess (Luke 2:36); the mother of Mary in tradition. Anna is a Hebrew name meaning “Grace; favour”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Anna expresses “Grace; favour”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Ḥannah, from the root ḥ-n-n, 'to be gracious', via the Greek Anna.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anna total 12, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
